title: Psalm 95 (O Come, Let Us Worship)
lyrics_original: Oh come let us worship and bow down;
Let us kneel before the LORD, our Maker!
Oh come let us worship and bow down;
Let us kneel before the LORD, our Maker!
And we are the people of His pasture,
And the sheep of His Hand,
And the sheep of His Hand.
Oh come let us worship and bow down;
Let us kneel before the LORD, our Maker!
Oh come let us worship and bow down;
Let us kneel before the LORD, our Maker!
And we are the people of His pasture,
And the sheep of His Hand,
And the sheep of His Hand.

bible_verses.english: Oh come, let’s worship and bow down. Let’s kneel before Yahweh, our Maker,
for he is our God. We are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. Today, oh that you would hear his voice!
Know that Yahweh, he is God. It is he who has made us, and we are his. We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord, my Maker and Shepherd, I come before You today with a heart full of awe and gratitude. Thank You for calling me Your own and holding me safely in Your care. Teach me to bow before You in true humility, surrendering my worries and desires into Your gentle hands. Guide my heart today as I worship You, trusting that You are good and faithful forever. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord, my Maker and Shepherd, I come before You today with a heart full of awe and gratitude. Thank You for calling me Your own and holding me safely in Your care. Teach me to bow before You in true humility, surrendering my worries and desires into Your gentle hands. Guide my heart today as I worship You, trusting that You are good and faithful forever. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: Worship begins when we pause to recognize who God truly is—our sovereign Creator and gentle Shepherd. Bowing our hearts and knees before Him is not an act of fear, but a joyful surrender to the One who made us and tenderly cares for us. As the sheep of His pasture, we are held securely in His hands, safe and fully known. Today, let us step into His presence with humble praise, resting in His unfailing love.
